issue.title: Add consistent ESLint configuration
issue.body:
## Problem
We need to ensure code quality and consistency across the repository, but currently, we do not have ESLint configured for our React/TypeScript codebase.

## Goal
Add and configure ESLint to enforce standard TypeScript and React rules.

## Where to Look
- Look in the root directory (or `apps/web` if scaffolding is complete) for package configurations.

## Suggested Approach
1. Install `eslint`, `eslint-plugin-react`, `@typescript-eslint/parser`, and `@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin` as dev dependencies.
2. Create an `.eslintrc.cjs` or `eslint.config.js` file.
3. Add a `lint` script to `package.json`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] ESLint is installed and configured.
- [ ] `npm run lint` executes successfully and reports any errors.
- [ ] The configuration supports both TypeScript and React hooks.

## Testing
Run `npm run lint` locally and ensure it parses the `.tsx` files correctly.

## Difficulty
`Beginner`

issue.title: feat(dossier): Add 'Copy to Clipboard' button for raw markdown in Dossier
issue.body:
## Description
In the Dossier page, it would be highly useful to have a small 'Copy' icon/button next to issue descriptions and comment blocks to easily copy the raw markdown text.

## Requirements
- Add a tiny, accessible 'Copy' button using a `lucide-react` icon (e.g. `Copy`).
- When clicked, copy the raw markdown to the user's clipboard using the standard `navigator.clipboard.writeText`.
- Show a brief visual confirmation (e.g., swapping the icon to a `Check` icon for 2 seconds).

This is a great first issue for anyone wanting to get familiar with our React frontend and Tailwind CSS!

issue.title: feat(radar): Add empty state illustrations when no eligible issues are found
issue.body:
## Description
Currently, when the Radar page finds zero eligible issues, it just shows a plain text message: `No eligible issues found matching your criteria.`
We want to improve this experience by adding a subtle, technical empty state graphic or layout.

## Requirements
- Do NOT use generic 'cute' illustrations. Keep it aligned with our 'Light. Precise. Technical.' design philosophy.
- Consider a clean ASCII-style graphic, a wireframe diagram, or a minimal Lucide icon layout.
- Suggest adjusting search criteria within the empty state text.

This is a perfect issue for a frontend developer with an eye for minimal, technical design!
